# Oinochoe (Pitcher)

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Oinochoe (Pitcher)
- **Artist / Maker:** Etruscan
- **Date:** 550-500 BCE
- **Style / Period:** etruscan
- **Classification:** pitcher (vessel)
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 172
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/172
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/09690ae8-43b3-4814-793e-af5ce930eea8/full/400,/0/default.jpg

## Extracted Source Palette
`#D8D8D8, #282828, #B8B8B8, #484848, #080808, #686868, #888888, #A89898`
